aesthetic_evidence.quote: Botox. This treatment relaxes facial muscles to reduce wrinkles and smooth away the visible signs of aging.
Laser Hair Removal. Embrace smooth, hair-free skin with advanced laser treatments that precisely target hair follicles without damaging surrounding tissues.

counter_evidence.note: Core brand is a personal-training/fitness studio (DEXA scans, bionetic personal training) with weight-loss and longevity programs; the med-spa is a location-specific service line, not the whole business

prior_reason_rebuttal: Prior reason said 'Fitness training studio ... no listed aesthetic services'. That was true of the homepage and core personal-training pages, but the sitemap also contains dedicated /conway/med-spa/, /fort-worth/med-spa/, and /lake-nona/med-spa/ location pages listing Botox, dermal fillers, laser hair removal, microneedling, Kybella (facial fat removal), skin tightening, and PCA chemical peels — a real aesthetics arm bolted onto the fitness/wellness business.
